data.body:
Re-close on the FIXED completion verifier (bug 2dcb landed as 8b8fa7c00645). Two verifier runs:

- Run 1 (aborted runaway read_file loop @153s): spurious 5-criteria FAIL — 3 of those (deferral/tallies/1200-run replay) have plainly discoverable evidence in the landed tests, so those 'evidence gap' findings were search-truncation false negatives.
- Run 2 (more thorough, still runaway-affected @252s): accurate verdict — AC1/AC3/AC4/AC5/AC6 all MET; only AC2 (venue-gated Cloud/DC verified fakes) unmet.

AC2 is a GENUINE gap, not a verifier fault: the S3 T3 commit (d49466b5e960) added only venue-AGNOSTIC coordinator-cutover tests (_ScriptedExecutor); it never delivered the planned 'venue-gate verified-fake Cloud/DC summary behavior' (Plan step 1 + AC2). My own grep of tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/ confirms zero Cloud/DC venue dimension in the coordinator tests. Existing Cloud/DC verified-fake suites (rich_text_cutover, dc_* characterization) test the ADAPTER, not the coordinator cutover.

Closing certified (no force) therefore requires COMPLETING AC2: add venue-gated Cloud/DC verified-fake coverage that drives the coordinator cutover (coordinate_and_fuse via a real guarded execute closure) for a summary-update through both a Cloud and a DC verified-fake backend, asserting venue-appropriate wire output + call ceilings + five-bucket tallies, passing before the default flip. Test-only completion; land through Gerrit, then re-close.
